text: Good food, large portion sizes! Went on a weekday and it was quiet, clean and service was friendly. Spinach artichoke dip is amazing. Mac and cheese is made with real cheese, super good. Actually just all of it, so tasty, so big - pictures don't do it justice. Took a bit of time to get the food to the table but it's 100% worth the small wait for the made to order food.

First of let me say I had a class reunion here when it was Latitude 69 and it was amazing.
They closed and came back as MAIN EVENT.
We've given this place 3 tries.
It's an amazing space with so much opportunity I don't see why they aren't doing more with it.
I love that it has such an awesome dining room space to watch multiple screens and then bowling and games and then there used to be a movie area or theater area.
Well let me say the games are not their strong point. They are super over priced and many malfunction. If you want have fun with games like that go to Dave and Busters. Old school games go to the arcade in Castleton. 
Sad thing is nothing seems really special about this place anymore and it's over priced. I hope it improves.
Favorite pizza place in the city, I've recommended to all my friends! They have limited hours but worth it.

Off their game today with service good was sub par it wasn't the freshest , most appealing meals for the price they charge . They did apologize and try to mend the issues but it wasn't appreciated for a night out to celebrate my brothers birthday . Probably will not plan any more special occasions here .

Doesn't look like much from the outside, a small converted tavern right on the side of 5th ave perched next to an auto shop..I probably would have never given it a second thought if not for the ravings of a few taste-trusted friends. The ambience inside is lovely, very dim, speak-easy type feel. They had a wonderful pianist playing a nice selection throughout our meal. We opted for the "secret menu" printed on the menu. lol The steaks were cooked PERFECTLY. Nicely seasoned, well flavored, and that CRUST. Far better than some of the usual fine steakhouse spots in the area. The scallops served with our meal were decent sized with a nice sear as well but they were SO incredibly salty. I'm not a person that shies away from salt but I almost couldn't manage, and my date actually couldn't. Everything else in the meal/wine/drinks were actually perfect. Our waitress looked a little unkempt and the service she provided was on par with that. A little meh, nothing superb, bordering on rude. Hopefully on the next visit the service will match the rest of the experience. Absolutely do recommend giving it a try!
This is the fish fillet sandwich I was served. The fries were cold and the plain double cheeseburger must have been made of concrete. Awful!

Opa!!! Great little lunch place!  Staff was helpful with suggestions but I always order a traditional grilled lamb gyro whenever I visit a new Mediterranean restaurant.  If they don't get that right then....
Thankfully, it was a really good gyro!! Generous portion of meat and toppings.  It wasn't the traditional thinly sliced lamb you would expect more like fajita style strips. Great flavor though.  Came with choice of side in addition to the potato chips.  I went with the basmati rice. If you don't like lemon you won't like this rice. The more lemon the better for me! My daughter got the chicken salad and the cucumber/ tomato side salad. Perhaps a little heavy w/the mayonnaise on the chicken salad but she liked it. The interior is bright and welcoming. Will definitely be back to try the Greek lemon chicken soup. They were out of it today.

Having worked at an Applebee's for 4+ years I expected slightly better. Ordered pickup and still managed to get awful service just picking up the food. However the worst of it was definitely the quality of the food. My salad was missing half of the ingredients and what it wasn't missing was day old, burnt crispy chicken. To think someone saw this chicken and thought it was acceptable for consumption is beyond me. Mistakes happen and forgetting cheese or toppings happens (FYI - cheese shown in photo was added from what I had on hand at home) but this chicken was completely unacceptable. Very disappointed and will not be returning to this locations.

This was my first time dining at Barbuzzo for restaurant week and the food was amazing. We first received antipasti for the table to share, and then I got some sheep's milk ricotta as the appetizer. It was very creamy and delicious to eat with the Italian bread. For my main entree, I ordered the crispy skin bronzino. The corn complemented the fish very well. For dessert, I got the salted caramel budino which was absolutely amazing. I highly recommend for anyone looking for a new dessert to try!

Can someone explain to me why this is the slowest, most disorganized Shake Shack on the planet?    I've been to plenty and it is the only one to get an order wrong and has the longest waits.   I don't get it.  The staff appear to have low energy and look dazed and confused.

First a little on my background, I have lived in Alabama for over 35 years, I work from Atlanta, and my momma and them come from rural, middle Tennessee. I know my Southern food and I'm always skeptical when I see " southern" anything on a menu and I'm not in the South. The Good- those scrambled eggs were perfect; not too dry, not too wet, perfect amount of cheesiness. The bacon flight was unique and I could eat a half pound of the candied bacon. The Bad- brown gravy is for Turkey and dressing, not for biscuits. And this was broken brown gravy, ugh. The Ugly- who in the world puts green onions on gravy?! No, no, no. I wanted to go in the kitchen and teach them how to make a nice, creamy, true southern sausage gravy. All you need is sausage, grease, flour,milk, salt, and pepper. Throw some cracked peppercorn if you wanna be fancy about it. That's it. Playing Kentucky Bluegrass revival on the speakers, putting "y'all" and " southern" on the menu doesn't cut it. But, the bacon... don't mess with that. That was good .
A little update: I forgot to mention the service. If I could give stars for service it would be a 5 of 5. Every person I encountered was friendly and hospitable. I didn't have to wait very long for my food to arrive. The atmosphere made up for the green onions on the gravy. :)

Reasonably priced food that will "Phil" you up!
You get a lot for a combo and the desserts are good!

Outstanding authentic Puerto Rican food. They recently opened this location and like with any other business has had some bumps. Service can be a bit slow. But if you're patient you'll enjoy the ambiance, the live music and the excellent food. I'll be back.

Edgar took our order in the drive through and was great, also super personable. Not to mention this in-n-out is always quick, even though its packed 24/7. The food is spot on every time as well! Much love from the 775.

Best Japanese in Reno I've had.  Not much choices especially no regular sushi spots all of them are AYCE.

Large variety of beers.  No draft.

Food was above average for Reno.

Friendly service. 

Didn't taste bin Cho tan on Yakitori, so probably just gas.  It was fine.

This is the second year in a row I've brought my boys here on Halloween morning to pick out a special Halloween cake. 

They've got a cake for everyone. I like that the prices vary- so that everyone can walk out with a cake (or cake order) that fits both their needs and budget. 

We come here all throughout the year for a coffee & pick-me-up. This is one of my family's favorite locally owned businesses. It's also a great place to stop in for a dozen donuts to surprise your coworkers!

Im not sure how I stumbled upon this place but the food is always Fresh and tastes Great. The shrimp fired rice is amazing by itself. Everytime I go now i try something different and I'm pleased with the flavors and the right amount of spice and heat. This is definitely not Mall food.
Prompt. Good portion. Tasty hash browns. I'm surprised for the low rating here. Good breakfast at this diner.

I went here with a friend. We sat outside (of course - COVID). It was quite chilly but so worth it. Everything I ate was hot and tasty. I enjoyed the chicken and shrimp francais with smashed potatoes and mixed veggies, mushroom barley soup and Thai chili wings to start. Haha, we were hungry! I enjoyed the mushroom barley soup so much. I order a quart to go and put in the freezer for work from lunches later. Service was great too. I will definitely return.

Cute little diner! We went around 12:30pm and it wasn't busy as I thought! Our server was very nice and reccomended us the pancake bar which was all you can eat! The cinnamon roll pancakes are soooo good! Great vibes, great prices, great people, and great food!
Food was incredible and huge!!! Had the sausage skillet that had so much flavor! One of the best breakfast places I have ever been to! Will definitely be back!

Very good Mexican food and the roasted pepper salsa is some of the best I have tasted, even in Mexico.

The service is friendly and quick and the whole staff works hard to give the diner a great experience.

We have gone several times to the restaurant and have done take out as well. Both hit our expectations. We plan to go more!

Excellent service, we walked in with no reservations and were seated promptly. But I did get the impression it is wise to make one. It was about 430pm on saturday so a early lunch. The menu is exquisite it has options for everyone. It was hard to decide.  

The price's of the dishes compete well with other Italian places. It was average about $15 bucks a dish. But well worth it. 

Food, cesar salad I would skip it. It was boring to me. I had to add salt and pepper. The complimentary warm bread and oil were a great compliment to the meals. I had the leo pasta and it was excellent, with the exception of the chicken breast it was dried out. My husband had fettuccine imperial. Now if you are a alfredo and mushroom lover this is right up your alley. 

Overall, I'll definetly be back when I'm visiting. If you are in a mood for great Italian food check this place out.

So I've been searching for a place with AUTHENTIC Latin food. I finally found it. So much food and soooo much flavor! This small little gem is easy to miss unless you know about it. I drove 45 mins to taste their food and I am sooo glad I did. The staff was very friendly and you're served in literally 5 minutes. The mofongo was why I came.. oh my god.. it's to die for! Stop in this place if you want a lot of good Latin food with lots of flavor.
Just finished our fantastic sushi meal.  The miso soup, tempura, salmon roe and our rolls were all perfection.  Will definitely have delivery from them again and again. 11-24-20
Fantastic. Went kinda late for lunch.  1:45. Buffet was up at 2.  Was like mmmm probably not.  Did it anyways.  It was all awesome. Can't wait to go back.

This is new, different and delicious!
Take a break and treat yourself.
Why not take the night off and bring 
home dinner! Guaranteed to return!

I came here thanksgiving day for brunch. I got to the diner during peak brunch time, around noon. My party of two was seated within 15 minutes. It took us about 20 minutes to get the order and about another 45 minutes to get the food. 
I ordered the chicken and waffles. My chicken was piping hot but my waffle was lukewarm. It was a tasty dish. I really appreciated the strawberry butter. 
The place was busy. It was a holiday. I would return and hope it isn't as busy.
Just a hole in the wall but the best California chicken sandwich I think I have ever had
Great entertainment!  Wacky cocktails, decent bar food, and friendly staff members.  Go see a show soon!

I dislike having to place my own food and beverage orders at the bar because there isn't a way to secure your seating while placing your order. There was an extremely long wait for food that was barely lukewarm. The means are unconventional for this establishment.  Ice made my drink taste like toilet water. The waitress was nice and the blue cheese was good.

If your in Reno and hungry this place is a must. Totally worth the wait. We ate our breakfast out on the patio over looking the river. Food was tasty and we were not disappointed. Will return but for dinner next time

Service is bad. Placed a pick up order, showed up early and was the only person waiting at window. Spoke with dirty uniformed person and had to wait for OVER 25 minutes. After a few more minutes I rang the "bell" twice!! and never saw another soul. Had to call the restaurant FROM THE WINDOW and just canceled my order. Very Disappointed. I hadn't eaten here in a Long time and was looking forward to it. I can only assume the experience represents the "new" Piada experience and probably reflects in its product as well.

Who doesn't love steak and shake? Right? 
However, at this location they have the greasiest floors I've ever came across. Like ice skating! Lol! clean it up guys. Cmon.
YUM! Get the crab Rangoon's they are the best I have ever had! Everything we ordered was delicious and probably the best Thai I have ever had!

So, they dont deliver anymore....they use door dash, which sucks! Cant even order an extra ranch if we want one. This place used to be awesome but the fact they switched to door dash is enough to make me not order from them anymore.  Too bad... they just lost a loyal customer.
The food was delicious but the servers did not wear masks.  Incredibly irresponsible; I wanted out of there as quickly as possible.  Will not be back. #thaidistrict

The smoked salmon is good. The key lime is decent. The cole slaw is good. 

I find everything here good, but not too exciting. 

I just moved here so have been waiting for the smoked mackerel, but they can't seem to find good enough for their standards to smoke. So, I wait patiently. 

I purchased whole smoked mullet fish. I must say I was pleasantly surprised as to how fatty and delicious. I came home and vacuumed sealed one and ate the other. 15
mins reheated in the oven with a pat of butter. I added some garlic salt and it was insanely good. Yummers.

I forgot that I have tasted their fish spread and had a sandwich. Not a single lettuce or tomato. Maybe I failed to ask. It was good, but not great enough for me to crave.
Bought duck ribs fries with melted cheese or whatever, too salty. Literally, unbeatably salty. Drinks were good though.

We're opened we're closed we're open we're closed. What the heck! 
Why did some favorites disappear during COVID?

Birthday dinner at Rocco's this week, inside dining. We had a lovely meal: 5 star drinks, 4-5 star food, plenty Covid safe. 
Drinks: excellent cocktails by the bartender-precise, tasty, generous- a nice wine, solid after dinner selections. 
Food: our appetizers were remarkable- ahi tuna poke and jumbo lump crab cocktail. Both were clearly thought through, and the flavors popped without overwhelming the tuna and crab. 
The salads that come with your meal are the exact opposite of the apps: standard, cheap, and bland. Next time, I'm not wasting stomach space on this salad. 
Our entrées were delicious: twin veal Oscar and prime rib special. Both cooked perfectly, well executed, and tasty to the last bite. 
Dessert: crème brûlée- good plus, but could be perfected. Berries? More vanilla? Bourbon? Add a note of something. Also, it's big. I'm glad we split it. 
Overall: mostly a 5 star food scene, with some moments of 4ness and the salad at a 1. Also, please turn the fire pits outside down a bit. I thought my hair was going to catch fire just walking by.

I have been meaning to stop here for a long time. My expectations were very high. The bar area is cool and staff is friendly. We got a large pizza with sausage and pepperoni on one side and arugula on the other. Good quality ingredients.

This is a cool spot! Stopped by with a friend for beers and nachos. Sat outside on the big patio. Really neat layout with fire pits, couches, lawn area, and games to play. Big beers were on special for $6.99 and nachos were affordable, too. Lots of beers on tap. Took a very long time for food to come out but we had beers so we were happy. Would definitely come back here again!

We had a really great time here tonight! We made a reservation on open table and got in no problem. They even had the high chair for the baby ready and waiting! The food was fresh and delicious! They have a great variety at the salad bar. We especially loved the carved pineapple! The meats were excellent too! I was very pleased that without ever mentioning it, they took note of our birthday celebration through open table and brought a complimentary desert and sang to my Grandmom as a surprise. I've made notes on opentable to other restaurants for birthday celebrations and they usually do not acknowledge it at all. Very pleased with our experience tonight!

Fiiiiiire!!! Just got the Train Wreck Po Boy and stopped half way to write this review. Ridiculously good. Best hot sandwich I've had in ages. The lady at the register was closing out and she's super nice. Thanks Becks!

Our favorite dish here was the appetizer that was a chimichanga which is thinner almost like a large taquito cut up in pieces that are bite-size and shareable with sour cream and guacamole on the side. I did not get a picture of this is we are quite hungry and we devoured the station less than a few minutes. Next time I would get two of these orders! Five stars for this order!

The tacos were average. I prefer street taco style that focuses on excellent meat with fresh cilantro and onion. 

We had the three item combo with And Asada taco, a chicken enchilada with red sauce, a pork tamale with green sauce. Unfortunately all three of these dishes I would describe is average and quite generic.

I did really enjoy the Paloma which was a generous portion with excellent grapefruit soda with Tequila. A friend had a margarita this was delicious as well.

I would describe five stars for the drinks and the appetizers and three stars for the main dish. Four stars overall..

They must changed ownership. It was my favorite place to go when I come to New Orleans. Most of the food here is still good but I ordered crispy Panko chicken and I was served frozen breaded chicken fry. It tasted just like chicken nuggets you get at fast food restaurants. It used to be fresh chicken breast coated with panko and fried. It was great. I was disappointed.

Have been ordering here for about 15 years. It has always been mediocre at best. Tonight has made it simply bad. 

We ordered a margherita pizza (sauce, fresh mozzarella, tomato, basil), but we didn't get that. Instead they sent a white pizza with sliced tomatoes on it. Spent 15 minutes on the phone with them trying to straighten out the order. They ended up sending us a text showing the menu ingredients saying we got what we ordered. Also ordered mozzarella sticks. There were only four in the container (even though the menu says you get 6) for $7.50. 

They lost a customer.

Stopped in when I had a break from work enough for a sit down meal. It was a Friday at 12 and it was empty. The bartender was personable and we chatted for a few minutes.  The building looks very average from the outside like an old ABC pizza location. Once you get inside it changes drastically, it's bigger than it looks. Tv's are all over and it has a sports bar feel for sure as many games were playing. 
I got a simple burger with bacon and cheddar, fries for the side. The burger was juicy  and delicious perfectly medium rare and I really liked it.  The fries were textured and crispy, man they were even better than the burger. Fast, cheap , and delicious this place delivered on a great lunch meal. I checked some reviews for spots around my job site and Yelp was right. This is my new go to spot for lunch. 
Do yourself a favor, pull up a barstool, watch some Bucs games and enjoy a good burger.
Authentic and delicious Mexican food that never disappoints. Everything on the menu is crazy good. And here's the kicker - lunch for 2 with drinks for well under $20!

Amazing gluten-free fried chicken that you have not tasted since you went GF. Many GF choices. We hope to return many times until we try them all. Owned by the same group as Jules GF Pizza located two blocks away.
Great food great service! Hostess lack customer service but besides them it's worth a try.

Few words describe how insanely delicious the food her is! On top of that, the service was warm, prompt & attentive. Our server, Kristi, went above & beyond what I expected.
I ordered the Bolognese (see pic), my daughter the pizza. I think it's their sauce that brings the food alive, but it's my best guess. We will definitely be back.
Best place in the area to get a bagel!!! Conveniently located with plenty of parking.

The PERFECT place to celebrate an occasion. We came to celebrate our 8th wedding anniversary. From the moment we checked in for our reservation to the end of our meal Staff continued to congratulate us. Our table was decorated with a card, sprinkled confetti on the table with a single red rose. Our waiter Rob B service was exceptional. He was very knowledgeable about the wine list, specials of the night, and the overall menu. I ordered The Rack of Lamb ordered medium.. seasoned and cooked nice and pink on the inside...perfection! Husband ordered Twin Lobster tail.. big, tender and cooked perfect as well. Ending our meal with a special desert on the house. What can I say.. The Perfect Place with The Perfect Meal...

I was working in Arabi for the week and was looking for something local to try.  Through yelp + instagram I found Kitchen Table cafe.  I did not know what to expect but when i got the food it was so amazing that i've been back several times

I first tried the lentil soup, which was good; the grilled cheese which was amazing; the salad which was also great; and the grilled eggplant stew which was more like a curry served with rice - but still good

Overall, great food with excellent flavor and good service

Love this place, my girls love it even more!  The BTS music is right up those alley. I'm not a fan of bubble tea, so while my girls ordered theirs I got a great iced coffee. We will be back, for sure.

I was there last night for a mini reunion.  It's a gathering place after work and ambiance is casual.  While there were a lot of people it didn't seem packed.  Someone forewarned me about the entree portion sizes and thought a pizza would be the safest bet.  I ordered the BIANCO VERDE  which has goat cheese, pesto, garlic almond and found the combination worked well.  

I doubt I'll be back.  The food combinations sounded great but it was so loud I truly couldn't hear much of the conversation of the people I was with.  

Oh, the bathroom needs to be disinfected and smells refreshed.  Think  Broad Street Subway.

Long time supporter of Brocatos subs.... after walking into Brocatos and realize they dont toast anymore, I had to find a new spot for my go-to cubans. 

Box of Cubans is ran by passionate people that care about their customers/food.  You can taste the passion

Absolutely love this place. My boyfriend and I ate at Bettina after an absolutely trash fire of a day and this dinning experience really turned it around. We were two hours late for our reservations (we are so sorry!) so we sat ourselves at the bar and had the delight of having Maggie as our bartender. Maggie, you are the real MVP. She made incredible food recommendations and a bomb-ass espresso martini. We can't wait to come back again and we promise to be punctual next time!
Great food. Great customer service. They even called to clarify takeout order details.

If you live within the Philadelphia area, this place is the place to go if you want pizza! This pizzeria caught my attention after a pizza review video done by Dave Portnoy from Barstool. One bite everybody knows the rules...

Pros: 
- the best pizza you'll get for your money 
- you can now call ahead and place an order a pie for pick-up (guess this is one positive of a pandemic) 
- HUGE portions

Cons: 
no real cons, just remember to bring cash with you as they are cash only.

We went online to checkout the menu. We've been to the one in Naples and liked it a lot. We thought it strange that there were no prices. Nonetheless, having been there before, we continued with our order over the phone with a young lady. We wanted curbside pick up, but my husband still had to go in and pay as they wouldn't accept payment over the phone. He went in and picked up the food. $83. When he got the bill it wasn't itemized and when he asked about it, the woman said she was too busy to get the details!????? We got home to hot and sour soup. Flavorless with only vinegar to season it. I threw it out. Pork fried dumpling were ok. Kung Pao Chicken was horrible with breaded chicken! My husband had Mongolian Beef and it was as tough and gristly. Inedible. I would definitely stay away from this P.F. Chang's until they get their act together. As far as I'm concerned, COVID-19 has nothing to do with very shabby service and sub-par food!!

Stopped in for breakfast on a Sunday morning.  Plenty of outdoor seating to be had.  Eagle breakfast was more than enough and included everything one could desire in a breakfast plate.  The outdoor seating was tented and comfortable. The service was on point and the food worthy of a come back.
Love this restaurant, love the chef tasting menu one of my favorite spots to eat!! The place isn't cheap but very worth it if your a lover of good food especially sushi!

This restaurant is awesome! Their food was very delicious. Montana is an amazing server and the evening manager Ashley came to apologize when our food took a little longer than expected, but it did not seem that it was that long! Very great service and I will definitely be coming back here!

This place is amazing! A must go to place! I used to go here almost every Friday last summer. Only reason I slowed down was because I couldn't afford to keep eating out that much. Lol. Every time someone asks me to suggest a place to eat this is my #1 choice! Every thing is delicious! Some of the best food I've ever tasted. The chef Meg is incredible! The staff is friendly. The place is always clean and has such a great atmosphere.

One Star for not authentic, horrible taste and terrible packing. I am sadly disappointed not sure if this business changes management. I found the place on Yelp, saw a pictures of pad Thai it's look ok so I thought I'll give it a try but needless to say I won't be back.
Beautiful restaurant. Excellent service. We have a diner with us who requires a gluten free menu. There were limited options for that. Nonetheless, we enjoyed our food.

Want to give a shout out to assistant manager Dan. I hosted my book club here last Sunday and he helped me out enormously by suggesting ideas for what to order for the group when I spoke to him a couple of days prior. Then, he really went above and beyond for my group when we met. Thanks again, Dan!

Needed to grab some food before a meeting and glad we stumbled upon this place. It was the perfect sense of spicy hot but not too hot and totally delicious! my pictures speak for themselves. We have yet to come back coz it's out of our area but we always talk about it so will have to go back for the chicken tikka masala and naan!

This place brings childhood memories, the smell of onions frying with the tomatoes and green chilies. The freshly taste of a perfectly seasoned carne seca in a flexible tasty hand made tortilla. Even though I attempted to place the order ahead of time and phone was busy for over 10 min, even though I waited outside in the heat I will definitely come back. If you enjoy Real Mexican food and you're not a Karen and don't mind waiting outside. You will enjoy eating here, highly recommended, the wait is well worth it.

First visit  - I had the Ivy League burger which is plant base, it was excellent (not an Impossible burger but just good) tomato soup was also very good - as an appetizer we shared avocado wedges also good - beer was cold and the service amazing

Totally fantastic family-run spot.  The one star reviews are all a little fishy to me.  Everything was truly great and generously portioned.  The salmon skin salad was the best I've ever had.  The Baltimore roll was uniquely delicious.  We placed a giant order despite there only being two of us.  Nice sushi breakfast the next day. 

"Late night sushi" are three words that signify true civilization.

Will be back!

As a brand new location with not a lot of fast food options nearby, it's understandable that it's going to take some time to get the kinks worked out to produce good food and the quantity and speed that you'd expect at any other fast food location. However, the customer service here is ALWAYS absolutely HORRIBLE. Barely acknowledged when you are paying, order not correct, no sauces for chicken tenders. I've been multiple times to give them the benefit of the doubt because o live nearby but it's always something. The food tastes great but it isn't worth the hassle. 

Update: Broke down because I didn't want to travel very far and it was late. Worse than before. What's the point of a drive thru when they take your payment and AFTER you've paid they ask you to pull up and park. 30 minutes later and still no food.  All that for five chicken tenders and some fries. Ridiculous. Never again.

While looking for food to be delivered that we don't have in our home town we came across Wing Xpress. We ordered grilled shrimp, cheeseburger, mild boneless wings, gyro and fries. No complaints on the food or service from Grubhub. The shrimp seemed to be the best option. Gyro was good. Covered in a lot of sauce. Which is ok with me. However, if you don't like a ton of sauce you'll want to order it with light.

Ok, basic. I wouldn't say good or bad but not sure I will go back. Still trying to find a good Chinese restaurant around this area.
Had the egg
Drop soup... not bad but lacking flavor and the hot and sour soup I would definitely not get that again, it's like the egg drop with added dried chili pepper flakes. 
Chicken fried rice wasn't bad and the crab Rangoon was ok, too much dough with poor dough to filling ratio for my taste. The sweet and sour sauce with it was good.
Workers there weren't very friendly and the place was a little
Creepy

My go-to for cheaper sushi.  Amazing quality for what you pay.  Great service, too.  The dragon and volcano rolls are highlights.  The hibachi isn't good, but the sushi here more than makes up for it.
Great place! I tried shrimp for the first time here! It was very good! The waiter was so friendly!!

We come here for family gatherings. They seem to have an ongoing promotion of buying $55 worth of food you getting a free noodle dish. The food is traditional and quite tasty if you know what to order. I suggest going with someone who is familiar with the cultural dishes to get the best bang for your buck. I find the food to be a little greasy and some dishes to be lacking the extra zip. The restaurant has a nice ambiance and is quite clean. The place is fairly modern and recently updated in the last few years. Parking is available and the staff are friendly and helpful. This restaurant provides great value for the quality and amount of food received.

Very disappointing visit to this restaurant.  I don't mind spending over $25 for dinner for just myself as long as I get what I want and a decent value but I didn't get that here.  I got the Sweet Soy Stir Fry.  60% of the serving was rice.  There was nothing sweet about it.  The breaded meat was a very small portion and I asked for it to not be spicy but it was.  I hate spicy.  
     I also got the Cobb Salad.   If a Cobb salad is supposed to be all hard white stems of the lettuce leaf and contain no green parts of the lettuce then I guess they got it right.   I was looking for a salad with green in it since we all know the greener it is the healthier it is. 
    I got a fountain drink for $2.40.   There was no  choice of small, medium, or large just TINY.  It was a flimsy 6oz. cup.  Once you put ice in it you end up with maybe 3oz. of drink.  I got takeout so no refills were possible.  I felt robbed.

Wonderful staff that helped me pick cigars for my boss. They have a huge selection and you can watch  the master cigar rollers at work. He loved medium cigars we picked out. They are all stored in a huge walk in fridge humidor.

Not a typical review, as this is about my time employed here. The manager who hired me lied about the wage I would be receiving, going so far as to have me sign a document with the wage he told me on it, then later writing over the number. I eventually found out and had a different manager find the document, and she could clearly see that the number had been written over. I had 3 separate managers write to a higher up on my behalf saying that I deserved back pay, but the GM basically refused to acknowledge me in any way and refused to pay me what I was owed. 

I was harassed by one customer in particular who came in regularly and refused to call me anything but sir because I'm a woman with short hair. He refused to drink his latte if it was made by a woman, he would literally bring it back claiming something was wrong with it every single time. He'd frequently tell me I needed to stop tricking him and look more like a girl, then randomly throw in that he had guns at home. I made it very clear to management that this man was harassing me and I didn't feel safe around him. They told me they couldn't ask him to leave, making it clear his $4 a day was more important than I was.

The best pho and Vietnamese food in Tampa. The food is always fresh and the service is fast. I love how efficient they are and still the food is also fresh. The prices are also great and I love their lunch specials. I also enjoy their fried rice and their crab Rangoon. Definitely encourage you to stop by if you are in the area.
Edgewood Cafe is my go to BYO in Havertown. Food and service are always great. I always get the chicken Parmesan which never disappoints. Make a reservation!

This is only based off one order but it was entirely inedible and that's saying something for us. We got the classic pad Thai... the driest noodle dish I've ever had accompanied by nothing but the flavor of burnt oil. Are you kidding me? When you put that many dishes out from hot oil on a wok that should be the first thing you know is wrong. Then we got the seafood soup. That was basically a perfectly good Tom yum flavored soup that they then dumped a shrimp flavored packet of ramen into. It was so salty it made our face pucker with every attempted sip. Then in the entire soup there was maybe one shrimp and two mushrooms... no rice or anything to accompany it. Okay. Seriously so bad it has put us off Thai food in general for a while.

Tried to go this morning and found it absolutely packed. Which it always has been, but times have changed, man. I don't understand why they're not limiting the number of patrons in the building. I don't understand why they're not having customers wait outside. I don't understand why they're not enforcing social distancing AT ALL. 

I mean, I do. They make their political leanings very clear. Thin blue line right on the door.

Shame too, I used to like this place. Fuck that. Black Lives Matter. Masks and distancing save lives. There are plenty of other brunch places in Boise.
As far as Covid goes this place felt very safe. The food was just okay. Not bad, just not great. It's a shame, was hoping for more

The people at the bakery were friendly and gave great service.  But I'm very sorry to say that the baked goods were sadly, not good.  

We got Four different things to try. There little cherry cheesecake was the worst one. The cherry was filling and it tasted like chemicals. 

We tried two cupcakes and both were dry.

The raspberry crumb cake was pretty good but the raspberry filling throughout the cake was not a good flavor or texture.

Sorry to leave a negative review because these were very nice people but the product needs some improvement.

What a great little place this restaurant was. If you enjoy great seafood really good atmosphere and a chance to enjoy turtle soup then this is the place for you. As an appetizer we got that truffled crab claws then we got seafood gumbo and yes turtle soup. It's a local snapping turtle and we were pleasantly surprised how good it was. For an entrée we shared the grilled redfish with the crab meat topping. It was delicious. The cocktails werent bad either. Lol. All in all a great dining experience. If you go ask to sit on the balcony and you get to watch a local band playing and people watching is always fun. Fella yelpers come visit this establishment.

Very small, feels underground with the black ceiling, no windows and rock interior wall.  Very intimate setting. Music was good- 5 price band was playing during our visit. Only downside was the restroom smelled horrible

AWFUL!  Came here before a movie because we were in the area and ordered from the kiosk.  Service was SO SLOOOWW!!!!  Had to go ASK FOR our food!!  Then, cheeseburgers came out cold!  Sent them back, (girl behind grill gave me a dirty look) waited 5 more minutes and 2 more burgers came back  cold AGAIN!!  I was so pissed!!  Sent my husband to get a refund and they only refunded $2 for 2 burgers on a $5.60 meal!!  I will never go to ANY MCDONALDS AGAIN!!  Terrible food!!!!1

Seriously the best Indian food I have ever had. And it's on the BESTBANK! The artwork inside on the walls is cool and funky and they play great music. But the food here is spectacular. It's evident they use highest quality spices and ingredients- every bite was better than the last. We had the tomato soup which was boss and cute little croutons in it, the vegetable soup also amazing. Followed by the deconstructed samosa which was the bomb and then butter chicken yum and the country curry chicken which was great too. Highly recommend everyone bee-line to Turmeric.
They only care about your money. The second they are close you are just an accessory that needs to be put away. I'm warning you now! If it's later than 8pm you'll get screwed over

$9 for a basic egg and cheese croissant??? No meat just egg and cheese that's insane.  It was good but no better than any other diner.  One of the waitresses was busy complaining that she thought she was the only one doing anything, always good for customers to hear.
Great shakes and burgers,  50% off during happy hours two to five PM. You will love it very much !
This was today 8-19-20. Description in post. Losing customers and future business! This is disturbing and employees need to be trained in safety protocols.

I was in Lakeview and wanted to get a salad so looked through the menu and decided to stop by Another Broken Egg.  I ordered the Southwestern Chop salad and instead of meat I made it vegetarian with mushrooms and avocado.  

The salad itself was good - big portion size, big piece of avocado and mushroom and good flavor.   

The service was alright - there are two entrances and i went through tons entrance and stood near the bar, and three servers passed me without giving me the information that i needed to go to the host stand to get my to go order.  the host provided good service and was pleasant 

Overall, a good salad but mixed bag in terms of service
Legit tacos! The chorizo y papa was the best chorizo I've ever had, and the carnitas were great too. And very affordable! Very friendly staff and they took all appropriate COVID precautions.

Ordered a Birthday Cake for my girlfriend here (a week in advance) and  I came in a week later to pick up my cake exactly at 3 (my scheduled pickup time). Apparently they messed up their orders and I find out they haven't even started on my cake. I'd have to come back in a hour so they could make it. To add even more bad news, they didn't have chocolate ganache filling that I ordered (the only reason I wanted the cake because she and I love ganache). So they offered a chocolate mousse filling instead, and I should've said no to the mousse because it wasn't very good. It honestly made the cake worse. Never been here before and I was so excited to try this Bakery! They let me down very badly today and it's gonna be hard to want to come back. Also, they told me when I arrive back to pick up the cake an hour Later, I would receive a $25 gift card for my troubles. I came back and no gift card. I've never left a bad review anywhere, it's just not something I've ever cared to do. But this really brought down my day.

Ummm, so this place lived up to the hype. Both the waiters were friendly and attentive. We ordered the Brussels sprouts (10/10), Krakken roll (9/10) and pingu roll (7.5/10). 

Overall, can't wait to come back here! Great food and service!

Are you looking for the worst high tea ever? Then this is the place to go. I would give less than 1 star if possible. My family and I always love to get tea and have a fun time but this was certainly a big disappointment and waste of money. We went there yesterday with my family for a lovely afternoon tea only to feel like we were robbed by the price, poor quality of food and tea and terrible service. They served watered down Bigelow tea, didn't bring us cream or sugar or even water. They ran out of scones. The sandwiches were marginal. Service was terrible. Their pastries were alright although there was way too much vanilla in the eclairs (which frankly seems hard to do but they managed that). Online they recommend calling for a reservation, which we did, but clearly no one wrote that down because they had no idea we were coming. Overall, I would highly recommend avoiding this place and saving your money. At $30/person we were certainly ripped off and wish we could have spent that money elsewhere on good food and a nice experience. Many thumbs down.
I love the atmosphere here. A bonus, you can hear the music from Judy's Velvet Lounge without going all the way in.
Love Salvos!  We eat there at least once a week. They have great pizza, spaghetti and desserts.

I used to love Choolaah and I still do, as I come here at least once a month (yes, I know, I'm a crazy "Choolaah Head"), but as time has passed since the opening of Choolaah, I'm starting to notice that servings are slowly becoming smaller and smaller. The portions used to be huge, but now they are just a normal size (which is fine). Quality has dropped a little as well. The rice is not cooked as well as it used to be, it is sometimes clumpy and a little hard. The cashiers are also not very clear either. On one occasion, I went with a friend and she ordered a side of white rice and a side of tikka masala, the cashier asked "would you just like the rice with tikka masala?" My friend asked if it was the same thing and the same size, I was about to tell her it wasn't, until the cashier said "yes". We got both of our orders, turns out that the singular rice and masala bowl was smaller than just getting them individually. She had also gotten brown rice instead of white. I still love this place and will continue to come here, but I am willing to recognize the flaws or this restaurant,

This is a great place to eat!  Fried chicken  with a kick.    Had their greens, Mac n , fries, and chicken.  Greens have good flavor.  Gave it 4 stars  because the fries were old.  Ordered a soda pop to my surprise you get a souvenir cup to take home.  Friendly service!!!

My fiancé and I love Quitutes. We've eaten there several times to go, and today we sat outside and had lunch on the patio with our pup for the first time. The staff was very nice and prompt, and the food was delish! Definitely recommend :)
I enjoyed the Shrimp Basket. I went back the next day just to get the shrimp. This will probably be one of my go to places.

I loved Hardena when they were opened normally before COVID, but now they actually have an amazing takeout option during these times called the #notpizza box!  I would highly recommend checking out their instagram and trying to snag one.  The box feeds a family of four, and between my partner and I we made it stretch for a hearty dinner into lunch leftovers.  We loved every single item - from spicy potatoes to different curries, we were exposed to a number of different really amazing dishes all in one box. 

As you can see from the photo, this pizza box is truly filled to the brim with all kinds of delicious dishes.  They had a whole fish in there too, plenty of rice, and a lot of veggies.  I feel like I'm not encapsulating how amazing the experience was, so you all will just have to order one for yourself! For people who aren't meat eaters, they also have a vegetarian version of this.  I can't recommend this enough - it was assembled with a lot of love, and worth every single delicious, colorful bite.  I can say with confidence, the #notpizza box is such a creative take on takeout and I would honestly order it again as a treat.
Super fun unique and exceptional experience. Every bite was outstanding, the cocktail pairing was also over the top delicious creative and just fun, highly recommend

The food was good the only thing I was not impressed with was the olde stuffed breadsticks they were very dry definitely needed a garlic butter sauce, it lacked any flavor for $8 other than that the food was very good

After reading the reviews I needed to seek this place out! I'm glad we went as the line moves quickly and everything was worth the money. 

We ordered the ribs, pulled pork sandwich, and nachos. Let's just say we didn't need breakfast the next day.  

I loved the nachos and pulled pork, but I prefer the ribs to be more fall off the bone style. Flavors were definitely there though.
Sushi is very fresh, excellent quality and great quantity. I absolutely love 'out of control' and 'sashimi' roles. The service is very friendly and professional.
I was invited there by friends & honestly didn't think I would find something that I like or be interested in, they definitely proved me wrong amazing taste & portion. Definitely will be back!!

Wonderful dive bar! Food is very solid. Their beer cheese and pretzels are amazing and a bargain- I think it's like $6? Onion rings are seriously some of the best I've EVER had. Seriously- everything is good. I've also been their for brunch. Brunch menu is not extensive, but again, solid. Bloody Mary's are amazing. Sometimes if they are slammed, service can be a bit slow, but it's because they are busy, not because people aren't doing their job.  And, the servers communicate with you when things are slow, which I appreciate- just keep me updated so I know I wasn't forgotten! They added outside seating at the end of the summer last year, I am excited to try it this spring!

*UPDATE*: Yesterday Koto reached out to my friend and has apologized. They offered her a complimentary meal and were very nice!  

My friend and I ordered 5 rolls and some dumplings for delivery on her 30th birthday. An hour and a half later, called to find the food was still "sitting at the restaurant". They apparently use a 3rd party delivery service and do not actually employ the delivery drivers. Ended up canceling the order because the dumplings would have been cold and the sushi dried out and warm... and they still couldn't provide an ETA. They were rude and getting refunded was difficult. Unacceptable.

We're doing our best to continue to support family businesses during this time of restrictions. Rich and Charlie's has always been a good one. We ordered curbside a couple of days ago. The Pesce was great as was the cannelloni and the veal parmigiana. The salads on the other hand were pretty soggy and we ate them as soon as we got them home. We were also missing an entire item. We shared food and it didn't kill us but while we are making an effort to continue supporting small /family businesses both ordering out and tipping as if we were dining in, I'd appreciate the same consideration from that business in checking to be sure the order is correct and salads haven't been sitting around so long that they're soggy. We'll go back but not until restrictions are lifted and we can dine in the restaurant.
I don't know why this location got bad reviews. I have gone twice, both of which the manager and team members were extremely friendly and had my food out in no time.

My Husband and I decided to drive into Reno for some good BBQ food. 2 of our Children had never been before so we knew we had to come. Our Server was Kevin and he was wonderful from the moment he greeted us. My husband use to work at Famous Dave's in Colorado so he asked if Kevin could tell the story behind all the sauces to our oldest son and he did proudly and even gave his own feedback on what he liked as well. We ordred the 2 person platter and it was such a great size portion it fed 3 of us with a ton of leftovers. Kevin made sure we had 2 extra Corn Breads since the 2 person platter only came with 2. Our favorite part of the meal was the Brisket and Ribs. I highley recommend trying all of the sauces because each one has a unique taste and depending on the meat seems to bring out a different flavor. The corn Bread is delicious also!! We had such a great experience thanks to Kevin. We told him we wish we could take him everywhere we went to eat because his service was the best we ever had! He even was generous enough to give my son a bottle of the Devils Spit BBQ sauce because he liked it so much! We will be back again and will be asking for Kevin Personally!

This place has gone downhill, me and my husband use to love coming here, but came to the bar tonight and it took over 20 minutes to get a beer and the girls behind the bar were horrible and the food was not as good as it use to be, tons of other options in the area

My husband and I have really enjoyed having breakfast at First Watch for a while now. The Countryside location moved to their new spot so we checked them out yesterday. It is very attractive and had the same great menu we've always enjoyed. I would have given 4 stars, but this new design has very high ceilings and is one, big, open room so the noise level was unpleasant. We mentioned it to our server and she said she was hoarse after the first day from having to speak loudly. It sounded more like a bar atmosphere than a breakfast/lunch place. I hope they'll consider installing some acoustic tiles or something to help absorb the sound.

I have visited 100's of coffee shops/roasters around the world. I love!!!! When a coffee house has a single origin espresso. It's by far a rarity, the next hurdle is when they can make a delicious pour over, both were on point here and they staff were super friendly.

We've been meaning to hit this spot since we moved to Donelson last April. Since the pandemic hit my husband and I have made it a point to get to go's from local spots and this week it was homegrown. I had the pulled pork hoagie with Mac and cheese and hubs got the meatloaf sub. We also got the pimento cheese starter. We. Loved. Everything! So delicious and the portions were more than generous. We can't wait to come back and try more menu items.

We ordered 2 breakfast sandwiches (bomb) and a muffin and almond claw I believe it was called. I would recommend this place to anyone, everything was good. The breakfast sandwiches were definitely made with love. They were very clean, I watched them change their gloves twice in the time I did my ordering. The guy next to me got a coffee and said it was good but I had already had mine for the day

This is a cool little spot! I've heard great things for a long time. There's usually a wait but not too bad. The inside dining is a really fun, open vibe. The food was good too, very much reminded us of a diner feel. Highly recommend the egg spaghetti dish!

I've been getting my pizzas from Riverside since 2005. They are, by far, my favorite! I also love the salads!
The owners are a really nice family.

I celebrated by birthday dinner here and couldn't have picked a better place! The service was amazing and the food was great as well. I was impressed that their seafood risotto was way better than a high-end restaurant I had gone to the previous night! 
My main entrée was the Florida Pompano and they gave a very generous amount of fish. I had enough for left overs. Everyone else in my party loved their dishes as well. 

The staff helped bring out a surprise cake that my friend brought. They even gave me a small box of truffles as a thank you gift. After dinner, it was nice to walk around the area before heading home. There's also an outdoor bar next door as well that I'll have to check out.

If I could give 10 stars to this company I would without hesitation. This review is based primarily on the customer service that I received from the Beyond Bread corporate office in Tucson.  I live in California and needed bread delivered to an individual address in Tucson. I found the Beyond Bread company online and was floored by the amazing manner that this company came through for me!  During this crazy time with the coronavirus, the customer service, the kindness and even the business ethic that this company showed was incredible. Thank you so much... on every business trip to Arizona moving forward, you have a customer for life!  Ps...the customer that received the bread said it was the best she had ever had.

First time here but I do love a good asian fusion place. Food is freshly prepared in an open kitchen so you can see everything going on. I'll definitely be back again. They offer stir fry and salads with seasonal locally available veggies. You can also build your own. Pretty cool if you ask me.

I had some friends come visit the city for the weekend and we decided it would be a good idea to get brunch in Fishtown.

One of my friends recommended that we go to Sarvida for brunch because most of hadn't been to a Filipino restaurant before and we thought this would be a great opportunity to learn more about her culture's food. I ordered a mango juice and pancakes with a side of soft scrambled eggs.
Each of us ordered something different so we could each try different things. I really enjoyed my meal and thought it was the perfect portion size for me! Each member in my party also loved their meal which is usually rare.

Also, I really enjoyed the music at the restaurant which made the experience more comforting and enjoyable. I would definitely recommend going to Sarvida for lunch.

Not normally a straight down the middle Mexican food fan, but their Pollo Feliz (a sautéed chicken breast with (hold the cheese), mushrooms, spinach, a side of rice and steamed vegs) provides something in the realm of healthy when I don't feel like cooking and my husband feels like a burrito. I mean he doesn't feel like a burrito, but he wants to eat one. You get it. Anyway, it's good.

I decided to try this place based on other's reviews.  I ordered a single burger and some onion rings.  The burger was, flat!  The buns were like soggy and cheap.  The lettuce, tomato, onions seemed old.  The onion rings were alright, but there were literally 5 onion rings, that's all!  Also, the girl taking orders at the front was not friendly at all!  No smile, no hello.  I will not return and I would not recommend this place for a good burger.
Mark is so amazing! Best Einstein/Bagel Place I have ever been to. I am so excited to come back for delicious food and a great time!!!

We actually love this place. Great pizza. Just extremely disappointed with the service at the end our meal.  We ordered 2 XL pizzas. We ate one and had the other one boxed to go. In the hassle of paying the bill and leaving we forgot to grab the pizza. We realized we forgot the pizza ( that's on us)...but when we called about 10 minutes after we left realizing we forgot our other pizza that we PAID for, we were told we threw it out ...."oh well  it happens".  Not let me see what we can do. I know we forgot the pizza but realizing it was a whole pizza not to hang on to it for at least 30 minutes just throw it out.  Maybe I am over reacting but I felt it could have been handled better than " it happens".

I had not eaten at a Panera Bread in years simply because I was not impressed the first time but my sis wanted to eat there recently and I am glad that I went back. 

My soup and sandwich was delicious! 
The service was quick and friendly!
The atmosphere was nice!
It was very clean!
And it was inexpensive!

Awesome food. I personally got the vegetarian Baja burrito. The chips and salsa were also on point. 

Quick service. Super friendly staff. Kid friendly. Great experience overall!

Just sat down and placed order. Waitress was super rude when we asked about the grouper tacos.  Will reserve judgement on the food, 1 Star.

Update - Chicken tacos and grouper tacos were smothered in a chipotle aioli which ruined the taste. 

Pizza Margherita flatbread was a caprese flatbread. 

Wouldn't come again

Really disappointed at Philly racism. We arrived at 5 pm on Sunday to an empty restaurant. We were told by the waitress/hostess that the seats facing the windows (and sunset views) were taken by a "large party" so we couldn't have them. We left at 7:30, and up until that point, only a small party of 3 white women had gotten seated (at 7:15 pm). Sounds about "white is right" to wait 2.5 hours for white women over 2 brown folks. Will not be returning.

The waiter is super friendly and accommodating. Very nice fine dininG place for couple or small group, the restaurant is quite small. The gumbo soup is really good, we enjoyed tHe appetizers, and entrees size are decent, great coffee cream brûlée. Great place for fine dining  while in town, close to our hotel Hyatt Convention. 4 days in New Orleans, I have to say, this place has the best Gumbo. Make your reservation here, do not go to commander palace (CP). CP food is very mediocre. Forget what your uber driver tells you, rebirth is better in many ways.

Great ambiance and probably one of the most unique spots that I have been to here in Philly. Even the location is removed from the main areas with lots of traffic. 3 floors that have different energies, but overall it's a really chill spot with a lot of fun cocktails. Book-themed with a number of different things to read while you're relaxing.

I ordered on site a salad for take out. 
I waited Outside for my  salad 
which was brought out to me.
My wait time was short. 
The salad was very good and 
I'll go back to try another food item soon.

I usually really like this restaurant for their guacamole, their enchiladas, burritos...  tonight we ordered the carne asada.  The meat was GRAY.  You couldn't even cut it.  At least we had guacamole.

The yakamein soup was so excellent I had to put blinders on as I walked past the truck to stop myself from ordering a second helping!  The soup was hot, flavorful with plenty of beef and it had just the right amount of kick.  I also sampled the bacon and brown sugar as well as the chai Madeline cookies and both were excellent! I absolutely cannot wait to try more menu items!!!  Thank you for coming to Community Health Alliance to give our staff an awesome opportunity to eat so well!

Thank for having the marketplace.  It's great being able to get groceries at a fare price without fighting crowds and germ.  The prepared food I bought made a great dinner tonight and many more meals to come.

I would have given 0 stars for service but the sushi is consistently pretty good here. I've been here several times and have only had one good customer service experience but this last visit to Wasabi was one of the worst service experiencesI've ever had. We waited about 10 minutes for someone to come to the front to greet us and then we asked if they had service outside and got an eye roll and an exhausted yes. The service was non existent. We had to ask for a water refill and had to go inside to get our bill. Unbelievably poor service. The sushi isn't good enough to deal with kind of rudeness.

Poor service and reasoning: I showed up with the family at 10:28am, but got to the counter at 10:31am. My brother who ordered just ahead of us got breakfast, but since we were after 10:30am they refused to serve us breakfast. Pedro (manager) insisted that if he make an exception with us, he would have to make an exception for everyone (even though there was nobody else in line)!  I insisted we had arrived before 10:30am but he said it doesn't matter. 

My daughter then asked for a bun with cheese (something she has gotten from countless other Chik Fil A stores) but they insisted they can't do that here. 

Very displeased about the quality of service and reasoning with this store. I will make a pointed effort to not return and would recommend finding another store where they value the customer and just basic thinking.

First time here and won't be the last. Way better than Quiznos. Had a Caprese sandwich and my wife had French Dip, both were great, but the dip was exceptional. Usually the meat in a dip is well done, but this was medium rare. Marvelous! The Caprese has big slabs of mozzarella and fresh basil. The tomatoes had plenty of flavor with a really nice hit balsamic. Definitely worth the visit!
Had the chicken and waffle. Very good. Premium chicken. Hot syrup. Friend had hit chicken sandwich. Fries are very good. Would go again. Prices are reasonable.

Really good when they get it right. I always get the same thing n honestly is rarely made the same. I guess I'm a sucker for the Mad Rancher tacos though because like I said if it's don't correcting it's delicious

Don't. Just don't go here. This place had a makeover and didn't upgrade the kitchen. Ran out of a bunch of stuff at 11am!  I am talking about supplies and chicken sandwich. This employee didn't even care and on top of it called me a liar. This is after sitting and waiting for my food for 30mins. 

Who the hell is the general manager here?  No original chicken sandwich. No chicken fry containers. I don't wanna know what else you don't have.

This girl needs to be fired!  After 30+ mins my order came out wrong!  I tell he it's wrong and she said i didn't order what i ordered. Called me a liar. Blames her teammates that they didn't tell her they were missing chicken sandwiches. I am very patient with restaurant industry.  But this was an absolute mess!  Whoever the manager is, call me. I already called into customer service so you have my info. What a way to start off Father's Day weekend.
